text:
PagerDutyBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: prod-gpu-west - GPU nodes exhausted, request queue >900, inference 503s increasing. Paging @Mira (oncall).

Mira: Ack. Who's got current autoscaler/ASG view? Any recent LT changes?

Samir: Looking. ASG rwin-gpu-west-1 is at desired=18, max=18 -> capped. Recent LT version lt-0f9bee included updated IAM profile ref 'rdl-prod-gpu-profile-v3' that didn't exist in account -> instances come up but fail to attach instance profile. Kubelet never registers.

Devon: From runtime: request queue spike started ~02:40 UTC after a small config roll (cache eviction). Because GPUs can't come online, backlog grew. We're seeing headroom at CPU-only pools but jobs require nvidia labels.

Rory: Kube bootstrap shows error: ```Feb 25 02:46:12 kubelet: E0205 02:46:12.123 kubelet.go:failed to assume role: AccessDenied: iam:PassRole not permitted for instance-profile rdlw-prod-gpu```. Nodes create but go NotReady. Autoscaler sees instances but they don't join -> pods unschedulable, so it doesn't scale further.

Mira: Immediate plan: 1) temporarily raise ASG max and desired to allow more launches, 2) roll back LT to last-known-good (lt-0f9bd), 3) divert small % traffic to cpu-fallback endpoint, 4) inform customers. Who can update ASG?

Samir: I can. Running: ```aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --auto-scaling-group-name rwin-gpu-west-1 --max-size 30 --desired-capacity 24``` starting now.

OpsBot: Autoscaling request accepted. Launching 6 instances. IDs: i-0b7caa, i-0d9ffaa, i-0cc33dd.

Nina: I'll open fallback route. Rolling 15% to cpu-fallback with degraded model. Also throttling non-interactive batch pipelines.

Devon: Reverted cache eviction to reduce immediate pressure. That should cut token churn.

Rory: Rolling back LT: changed ASG launch template to lt-0f9bd (version 4). Command: ```aws autoscaling update-auto-scaling-group --launch-template LaunchTemplateId=lt-0f9bd,Version=4 --auto-scaling-group-name rwin-gpu-west-1```. New instances will use older profile.

Samir: New instances booted but some still show NotReady. Checking cloud-init/kubelet logs. Found that userdata in the bad LT had truncated awscli install, causing kube-proxy to fail. That's why some nodes flapped.

Devon: Can we cordon & drain problematic nodes and force new ones to be provisioned?

Mira: Yes. Rory, cordon & drain the flapping ones. Samir, ensure ASG terminates unhealthy and replaces.

Rory: Executing: ```kubectl cordon gpu-node-41 gpu-node-42``` then ```kubectl drain gpu-node-41 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data -l role=gpu```. Drains started.

Samir: ASG health checks are set to ELB; instances failing bootstrap marked Unhealthy -> terminated and replaced. I've set autoscaling-group --default-cooldown 120 and ensured termination_policy oldest-launch-config.

OpsBot: Instances i-0b7caa became Ready at 02:56:18. i-0d9ffaa marked Unhealthy and terminated, new i-0ee44ff launched.

Nina: Fallback routing in place. Observability: 503 rate dropped 40% after initial actions, latency improved slightly. Queue length trending down from 920 -> 260 in last 18 minutes.

Mira: Good. Next ephemeral fixes: 1) keep ASG max increased for 1 hour, 2) block LT promotions until smoke tests pass, 3) create autoscaler alert for "nodes launching but not Ready" and tie into runbook. Assign follow-ups.

Devon: Noted: we should add a preflight check that validates instance profile exists and awscli/userdata hooks succeed before promoting LT.

Rory: Post-incident tasks: update infra runbook to detect iam:PassRole bootstrap failures (grep for 'PassRole' in kubelet logs), add automated rollback on repeated bootstrap failures, and add alert that fires when scheduling failures due to taints/selectors > 5m.

Samir: Customer comms sent: short message + ETA 45min. Support flagged 2 enterprise customers for direct outreach. Captured request IDs and sample traces.

Nina: Batch pipelines throttled to 20% parallelism, freeing up GPU slots for latency-sensitive workloads.

OpsBot: Cluster events: "Node gpu-node-41 Ready" "Node gpu-node-43 Ready". Scheduler is placing GPU-demand pods.

Mira: Queue now ~130, 503s near zero, latency back to SLO. Holding monitoring for 30m. Assigning postmortem owners: Samir (infra LT rollout), Devon (runtime & caching), Rory (k8s bootstrap/runbooks).

PagerDutyBot: Incident marked MITIGATED by Mira. If new symptoms appear reactivate the page. :white_check_mark:
